final_assistant_text:
Case N37 is complete. Final mask saved (v1, 9.9 mL, single component):

- **Lesion**: fusiform T2-hyperintense peripheral nerve sheath tumor anteromedial to the femur, spanning axial 71–113, coronal 91–112, sagittal 110–134 (~42 × 22 × 24 mm).
- **Approach**: located with axial/coronal/sagittal sheets, seeded with one positive point at the tumor core, then verified the boundary on zoomed axial, coronal and sagittal sections at both poles and the mid-portion.
- **Excluded**: the adjacent bright femoral vessels (artery/vein), the long bright vascular stripe running craniocaudally, and all automatic candidates (C1–C5), which corresponded to vessels/fat rather than tumor tissue.
- **Confidence**: high — outline matched the lesion edge in all three planes and no lesion tissue was present in the past-the-mask review panels.
